label: Direct per-se conservation of esse: Preservation under which the preserved creature depends for…
definition: Preservation under which the preserved creature depends for its being on the preserver's continuing esse-giving action. In q.104 a.1 the divine action is not a new production at each temporal instant and is described as without motion or time. This source definition neither stipulates a Lean relation nor equates every nonexistence counterfactual with a cause.
note: Declaration-completion investigation (2026-11-09): TruthCore.Causality.PreservationCandidates.ProductiveCandidate is an explicitly incomplete analyst candidate, not this sourced definition. It requires an existing bearer, ongoing action episode, agent and recipient, and a givingEsse contribution role. Controls separate it from interception and show that existence alone, a ceased action, or an absent bearer do not suffice. OPEN formal content: givingEsse has no analysis of productive receipt of this same bearer's esse or dependence on the continuing action; its constructor does not supply that analysis. No declaration binding or original sense allowance is removed. Existing CausesIn at esse and ActualEsseCausesSupportAt are supplied-relation interfaces, not definitions of production. Root application plan: first supply productive contribution/dependence semantics without annihilation/recreation; then register an explicit conservation-to-CausesIn premise and consume the existing selected-world support interface on the cause-of-esse/necessary-being route. Neither interface is established here. Independent real-world warrant may remain open during that conditional study; the present blocker is missing formal content, not lack of warrant.
